# Lua script API reference

Scripts automate the board: a script queues tool calls, the daemon runs them in order as the caller once the
script ends. Run one with `infantry_script_run` (MCP) or hook it to an event with `infantry script hook add`.
`infantry_script_api` prints the live version of this page, with every tool the caller may queue (see the
[MCP tools reference](mcp-tools.md)).

## The `ih` binding

From `rust/crates/infantry-scripting/src/lua.rs`.

```text
Lua 5.2, sandboxed: no io/require/load; os.time, os.clock, string, table, math only.
ih.call("infantry_ticket_move", {ticket="t1", status="done"})   queue any tool by registry name
ih.move{ticket="t1", status="done"}                            same, by an alias (ih.<alias>{...} or ih.<toolname>{...}); args are ONE table of the tool's named arguments
ih.call("readaloud.speak", {text="hi", _target="all"})         call a plugin capability by its dotted id (infantry_capability_list); _target = default | all | <host id>
ih.notify{title="Build failed", level="error", dedupeKey="build"} post on the core notification bus (level info|success|warning|error|urgent)
ih.exec{command={"prog","arg"}, cwd=".", timeoutSec=60}        run a process (needs scripting.exec.enabled); phase 2 input.results[i].json = {exitCode, durationMs, stdoutTail, stderrTail, timedOut}
ih.cli("prog arg")  or  ih.cli{command=..., ...}                same as ih.exec (a bare string is the command line)
ih.log("text")                                                 add to the run log
ih.again()                                                     after this run's actions execute, re-run the script with the results
Nothing runs inside the script: actions are queued and executed in order after it ends; the first failure stops the run.
input.args   the --args object;  input.phase  1, then 2.. after ih.again();  input.caller  {id, role}
input.results (phase 2+)  list, one per executed action in order: {name, tool, ok, text, json}  (json = the tool's answer when it is JSON)
Example: if not input.results then ih.move{ticket=input.args.ticket, status="done"}; ih.again()
         else ih.comment{ticket=input.args.ticket, text="moved: "..input.results[1].text} end
```

## Aliases

A short name for a tool: `ih.<alias>{...}`. The built-in aliases are always there; the default table applies while the
setting `scripting.aliases` is unset (a stored JSON object replaces it).

| Alias | Tool | Kind |
|---|---|---|
| `exec` | `infantry_exec` | built in |
| `cli` | `infantry_exec` | built in |
| `exec_status` | `infantry_exec_status` | built in |
| `progress` | `infantry_progress` | built in |
| `chat_note` | `infantry_chat_note` | built in |
| `chat_image` | `infantry_chat_image` | built in |
| `session_act` | `infantry_session_act` | built in |
| `notify` | `infantry_notify` | built in |
| `spawn` | `infantry_spawn` | built in |
| `prompt_answer` | `infantry_prompt_answer` | built in |
| `move` | `infantry_ticket_move` | default |
| `comment` | `infantry_ticket_comment` | default |
| `message` | `infantry_message` | default |
| `start` | `infantry_ticket_start` | default |
| `close_session` | `infantry_session_remove` | default |
| `kill` | `infantry_kill` | default |
| `prompt` | `infantry_prompt` | default |
| `ask` | `infantry_ask` | default |
| `ticket_get` | `infantry_ticket_get` | default |
| `ticket_update` | `infantry_ticket_update` | default |
| `ticket_create` | `infantry_ticket_create` | default |
| `board` | `infantry_board` | default |
| `secret_render` | `infantry_secret_render` | default |

## Hooks

`infantry script` manages scripts and the hooks that run them:

```text
usage: infantry script hook list | add <on> <script> [--payload <args json>|-] | remove <id> | save <name> --title <t> --description <d> [--tags a,b] [--scope global] [--file <path> | --body -] | list [--query <text>] [--sort used|recent|failing|unused] | delete <name> | files export|import [--scope global] [--dir <path>]   (<on>: "lane enter done", "lane exit in_progress" or an event name like ticket.commented)
```

## Bundled scripts

The starter set every install has (`rust/crates/infantry-scripting/global-scripts/`). Each file's first lines say
what it does and which `input.args` it takes.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `comment-tail.lua` | read-only: print the last N chars of a ticket's latest comment of a kind (tool results are cut at the MCP limit) |
| `done-forward.lua` | when a watched ticket enters done, mails its latest done comment to another project's PM, push-notifies the owner, optionally starts the next ticket; fires once |
| `find-ticket.lua` | read-only: print the board lines (backlog, todo, in_progress by default) that contain a text; board output is capped over MCP |
| `goal-autostart-off.lua` | when every goal ticket is done, re-adds the done-enter hook with auto-start off and tells the PM |
| `goal-handoff.lua` | when every goal ticket is done, hands the machine to another project: mails its PM and tells our PM to start nothing until handed back; fires once |
| `hook-health.lua` | watches every script's run history; alerts when a script fails N runs in a row (the watcher of the watchers) |
| `lane-one-worker.lua` | keeps at most N ticket workers in progress, bounces the extra one back to todo, and prompts a freshly started idle worker |
| `lane-park.lua` | a ticket leaving in_progress for anything but the done lane, or entering backlog, gives up its worker |
| `lane-pending-note.lua` | says on the ticket that it waits on prerequisites; when it leaves pending for the start lane, starts it |
| `lane-pin-check.lua` | makes sure a ticket's provider/model pin is allowed before it runs; repins (or sends it back to todo) when not |
| `mem-check.lua` | checks free memory and reaps leftover processes the daemon attributes to ended or idle sessions; notes the PM when memory is low |
| `needs-owner-alert.lua` | raises a system notification when a ticket comment asks for the owner ("needs owner", "[Q: owner", "owner decision needed") |
| `usage-governor.lua` | reads the weekly usage pace and steps worker capacity: normal -> one worker -> cheaper model only; restores when the pace drops |
| `wake-on-log.lua` | waits (in a process) for a log file to print a pattern, then wakes a session; for a dev UI or daemon that never ends |
| `worker-cap.lua` | how to change the number of parallel ticket workers; prints the effective cap and why, and with fill=true starts todo tickets up to it |
| `worker-issue-wake.lua` | wakes the PM at once when a ticket worker stops with an open ISSUE comment, instead of waiting for the idle kick |
| `worker-silent-ping.lua` | asks a ticket worker for status when it is busy (or waiting on a background job) but has written nothing for N minutes |
| `worker-waiting-nudge.lua` | one plain nudge to a ticket worker that went idle with no report and no "waiting" flag; one "still waiting?" nudge when its flag ran out |
